name: go-api-design
description: > HTTP/REST API design for Go services: handlers, ServeMux routing, middleware, request validation, pagination, idempotency, health checks, error responses, and graceful shutdown. Use when designing APIs, writing HTTP handlers, implementing middleware, or structuring REST endpoints. Trigger examples: "design API", "REST endpoints", "HTTP handler", "middleware pattern", "graceful shutdown", "API versioning". Not for: gRPC services (go-grpc), spec-first OpenAPI work (go-openapi), general architect
author: eduardo-sl
